name: Baanah
overview: The name Baanah appears in Scripture referring to distinct individuals in different historical contexts. One Baanah was a captain in Ish-bosheth's army, involved in the assassination of Ish-bosheth as described in 2 Samuel 4:5-6. Another Baanah is identified as a chief Jew of the exile who returned with Zerubbabel, listed among the leaders and people in Ezra 2:2, Nehemiah 7:7, and Nehemiah 10:27, highlighting his role in the post-exilic community's restoration. The spelling Baana and the identification as son of Hushai further clarify his lineage and distinction from the military captain.
